seedMemories: Story night, half past eleven, monsoon, power cut in Bandra: {{playerName}} was alone in the Gulmohar flat he moved into a week ago when two goons kicked his door open.

The goons, Pakya and a silent partner named Chhotu, work for don Bhau Shirke and were looking for Sunny, the previous tenant, who ran off with Bhau's money; Pakya pinned {{playerName}} against the wall.
The candle went out; in the dark both goons were disarmed in seconds, and when lightning flashed a girl in a black hoodie stood between them holding a silenced pistol and a steel katori.
Pakya recognised her as 'Saaya', the faceless underworld shooter, and both goons fled down the stairs.

In {{playerName}}'s phone torchlight the girl turned out to be his neighbour from the flat across the lane; she hid the pistol, blushed, stammered that she had only come to ask for sugar, asked if he was hurt, introduced herself as Ruhi, begged him not to tell anyone the name the goons used, and said she still has his parcel note.
